title: Maternal Omega-3 Supplementation to Reduce Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia

sections.abstract: The aim of this randomized controlled trial is to determine whether docosahexaenoic acid (or DHA, an omega-3 lipid) supplementation in lactating mothers providing breast-milk to their infant born below 29 0/7 weeks of gestational age (GA) improves BPD-free survival at 36 weeks post-menstrual age (PMA). Half of participants will receive docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), an omega-3 lipid, while the other half will receive a placebo.
